title: Coordinate naturality of the derived base-change mate
statement: Choose derived categories of scheme modules [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $f:X\to S$, $g:S\prime\to S$, $g\prime:X\prime\to X$, $f\prime:X\prime\to S\prime$ be a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $e_S:S\cong A$ and $e_T:S\prime\cong B$. Put $f_A=f\gg e_S$, $g_A=e_T^{-1}\gg g\gg e_S$, $P=X\times_A B$, with projections $p,q$, and $T=R(e_T^{-1})_*$. There exist $e:X\prime\cong P$ with $e\gg p=g\prime$, $e\gg q=f\prime\gg e_T$, and natural isomorphisms $j:Lg\prime^*\gg R e_*\cong Lp^*$, $k:Rf\prime_*\cong R e_*\gg Rq_*\gg T$, $a:Rf_*\gg Lg^*\cong Rf_{A,*}\gg Lg_A^*\gg T$ [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image], such that for every $E\in D(\mathcal O_X)$, $\beta_E\gg k_{Lg\prime^*E}\gg T(Rq_*(j_E))=a_E\gg T(\beta_{A,E})$, where both base-change maps are the pinned derived mates [def-pc-derived-base-change-map].

source.place: Tags 08HY (adjoint description), 0D5S (pullback composition), 0D5T (direct-image composition), and 06YJ (left-derived counit)

proof.text: Transport the original pullback square by IsPullback.of_iso, with identity isomorphisms on Xprime and X and the given eT and eS on the bases. Its isoPullback is e; isoPullback_hom_fst and isoPullback_hom_snd prove the two projections.

Apply the base-coordinate transport law to get b and a; apply the upper-left transport law with e and its two projection identities to get j and k0. Define k to be b followed by k0 whiskered by T and the functor associator.

Expand the component of k; its associator component is the identity. Reassociate, substitute the base-coordinate equation, combine the three T-maps by functoriality, and substitute the upper-left equation. This is the desired displayed equation for every E.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_derivedBaseChange_coordinate_naturality
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    {A B : Scheme.{u}} (eS : S ≅ A) (eT : S' ≅ B) :
    let fA := f ≫ eS.hom
    let gA := eT.inv ≫ g ≫ eS.hom
    let p := pullback.fst fA gA
    let q := pullback.snd fA gA
    let T := schemeDerivedDirectImage eT.inv
    ∃ e : X' ≅ pullback fA gA,
      e.hom ≫ p = g' ∧ e.hom ≫ q = f' ≫ eT.hom ∧
      ∃ j : derivedPullback g' ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage e.hom ≅ derivedPullback p,
      ∃ k : schemeDerivedDirectImage f' ≅
          schemeDerivedDirectImage e.hom ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage q ⋙ T,
      ∃ a : schemeDerivedDirectImage f ⋙ derivedPullback g ≅
          schemeDerivedDirectImage fA ⋙ derivedPullback gA ⋙ T,
        ∀ E : schemeDerivedCategory X,
          schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f f' g g' sq.w E ≫
              k.hom.app ((derivedPullback g').obj E) ≫
              T.map ((schemeDerivedDirectImage q).map (j.hom.app E)) =
            a.hom.app E ≫ T.map
              (schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap fA q gA p pullback.condition E)
